ui.startSub: A 3D adventure · Collect 10 light crystals · Purify the shrine

slime_blue.name: Meadow Slime
slime_blue.desc: Slow blue slime from the meadows. 2 HP.

slime_purple.name: Mist Slime
slime_purple.desc: Fires purple projectiles from afar. 3 HP.

boss_nebelkoloss.name: Mist Colossus
boss_nebelkoloss.desc: Ancient guardian of the shrine. 25 HP, 2 attacks.

shrine.name: Emerald Forest Shrine
shrine.desc: A decayed shrine at the end of the forest.

dialog.elder_intro: Aren, my child. The Emerald Forest shrine has been corrupted for decades. Gather ten light crystals from the meadows — they will purify the sanctuary. But beware: an ancient guardian, the Mist Colossus, guards the gate.
dialog.boss_warning: You feel the ground tremble. The Colossus awakens. His breath carries the poison of a lost age.
dialog.boss_defeated: The guardian is defeated! The shrine lies open before you.
dialog.victory: You've done it, my child! The shrine blazes — the crystals have returned the light. Sunhallow celebrates your name.
dialog.shrine_locked_crystals: The shrine is still corrupted. It needs {remaining} more light crystals.
dialog.shrine_locked_boss: The Mist Colossus blocks the shrine! Defeat him first.
dialog.elder_intro_era1: Eight-bit era. NES time. Aren, you can only move in 4 directions - use ARROW KEYS. Defeat the BLOCK SLIMES and bring 10 CRYSTALS to the shrine.
dialog.elder_intro_era2: Sixteen-bit era. SNES time. You can now move in 8 directions - WASD. The PIXEL SLIMES are stronger. Use SPACE to cast magic.
dialog.elder_intro_era3: Three-D era. Finally REAL. Free camera, precise MAGIC SLIMES with special abilities. Show them what you can do.
